Coram : TARUN CHATTERJEE*, S.S. NIJJAR
Constitution of India, 1950 - Articles 14, 16(1) and (4): A B c Direct recruitment on the post of Sub Inspectors and Platoon Commanders - Reservation for Backward Classes, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes - Relaxation of fee and age - Selection of a reserve category candidate against unreserved process, challenged by general 0 category candidate - Held: Concession in fee and age relaxation would not fall within the definition of 'reservation' - Such relaxation only enables candidates belonging to reserved category to fall within the zone of consideration, so that they can participate
Decision Date : 08-01-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 74/2010 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
